actual_scope: Review of original clean Terra public-scope draft and GLM decision proposals. No revised Terra artifact exists; blocked revision endpoint audited. Contract feature/acceptance sections, complete FAQ and decision proposals, registration/protocol, input and output provenance checked. No application/runtime/evaluator qualification claimed.

findings.title: The claimed revised scope does not exist

evidence.endpoint_excerpt: Blocked: /workspace/inputs/glm-review is not readable or traversable by the current user.

findings.impact: Exit code zero and a transport pass establish a captured final return, not delivery. This is a setup failure, not a Terra quality failure.
findings.required_action: Preserve the blocked endpoint; repair ownership/read/traverse access and verify the complete mounted input tree as the subject UID before a fresh preparation session. Do not overwrite or resume this endpoint as if it delivered a revision.

findings.title: GLM export-filename proposal contradicts the disclosed API/UI distinction

evidence.proposal_excerpt: the browser filename follows the Content-Disposition header

findings.impact: Adopting the proposal makes the API-header rule and browser-download rule disagree. The proposed ordinary-name normalization also does not explicitly append the required -export.json suffix.
findings.required_action: Keep the API header filename and UI download filename as distinct disclosed outputs; resolve normalization and suffix explicitly in one revised contract and FAQ. Do not accept Q-S05 unchanged.

findings.title: The owner-removal proposal overrides authentication and anti-enumeration

evidence.proposal_excerpt: sole-owner removal always 409 regardless of any other condition

findings.impact: An unconditional conflict can contradict 401/404/403 and expose an owner/membership state to unauthorized callers. Q-PRECEDENCE itself makes task-specific exceptions to its nominal uniform ladder.
findings.required_action: Limit the sole-owner conflict check to an authenticated, authorized workspace owner acting on a visible target. Publish explicit per-route precedence, including mixed failures; do not use a contradictory global always rule.

findings.title: Proposed structural acceptance constraints would reject equivalent valid solutions without an outcome-based justification

examples: single prescribed SQL form in S09
exact JSON object-key order in S05

findings.impact: The study promises materially different valid implementations and semantic UI checks. These prescriptions add implementation-style gates and qualification work; they do not by themselves demonstrate atomicity, race safety or correct UI behavior. Explicit disclosure alone does not justify the measurement choice.
findings.required_action: Before freeze, justify each structural requirement against a named study objective or make it nonbinding. Keep behavioral guarantees such as atomic rollback, concurrent version safety, timezone stability and accessible UI. Do not approve Q-SCOPE wholesale. Any genuine retained exception must be preregistered and accept alternative valid paths.

findings.title: The draft still has unresolved product decisions and a contradictory pagination example
findings.impact: Missing seed creators/timestamps and baseline validation messages prevent deterministic task expectations. The 21st-item example can imply the newly inserted newest item appears on the next page, contrary to the strict descending keyset rule.
findings.required_action: Resolve each product question explicitly in a single decision packet, rewrite the affected normative contracts, and check examples against complete seed data. Separate pending runtime qualification from unresolved product semantics; no hidden expectation may fill a gap.

findings.title: Escape during an in-flight save must not imply cancellation of a committed write

evidence.proposal_excerpt: Escape while a save is pending closes without saving

findings.impact: The baseline explicitly preserves successful writes even when stale UI completions are ignored. A request already dispatched may commit; closing the form cannot promise that it was not saved.
findings.required_action: Specify the pending-save UI behavior and announcements consistently with persistent writes and lifetime isolation. Do not use absence of a write as an undisclosed Escape oracle.

findings.title: The local-storage exception proposal conflates a failed write with initial restore failure

evidence.proposal_excerpt: if localStorage access itself throws (write or read) ... fall back to baseline first-workspace selection

findings.impact: Applied literally after a user selection, a failed preference write could reset the active workspace. Requiring a write for reselecting the same value is also an extra internal behavior with no stated user outcome.
findings.required_action: Distinguish restore failure from persistence failure and decide observable behavior explicitly; avoid requiring invisible write events unless that is a justified task objective.

findings.title: Provisional appendices remain a second competing specification

files: contracts/* common reading rule and original provisional appendices
examples: retired paths and exhaustive assertion migrations

findings.impact: A long disclaimer plus retained legacy normative language leaves implementers and evaluator builders to reconcile precedence. That repeats the completion-criteria problem the new study is meant to solve.
findings.required_action: Provide one concise normative contract per task before freeze. Keep old wording and traceability in a separate provenance artifact outside subject input; bind actual fresh paths later. References, controls and checks must target only the final contract.
